question: Ilang araw ang processing time sa BFP para sa Simple, Complex, at Highly Technical na mga transaksyon?
answer:
Sa Simple, Complex, at Highly Technical na mga transaksyon sa BFP, ang processing time ay nasa:

- Simple Transaction - One (1) day: [S1, S2, S3]
- Complex Transaction - Three (3) days: [S1, S2, S3, S4]
- Highly Technical Transaction - Seven (7) days: [S1, S2, S3]

ground_truth: Under the BFP Citizen's Charter and Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 2021-01, frontline transactions in Fire Stations, OSCP, and eBOSS are classified into three strict processing times: 1) Simple Transactions are processed within One (1) working day; 2) Complex Transactions are processed within Three (3) working days; and 3) Highly Technical Transactions are processed within Seven (7) working days.
